title: Titanium Submarine Steering Rudder Pin
function: Marine steering rudder actuator pivot pin
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Grade 5, UNS R56400) was selected for this propulsion application because its 900+ MPa tensile enables thin-wall lightweighting under cyclic loading. The alpha-beta microstructure provides 45% higher specific strength than 4140 steel, critical for weight-sensitive designs. Its 6.7 W/mK thermal conductivity simplifies thermal management. This rationale is driven by marine steering rudder actuator pivot pin and fat life requirements.
process: Ring forging radial-axial for propulsion geometry

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Submarine Steering Rudder Pin suitable for Marine steering rudder actuator pivot pin?
faq.a: Titanium Submarine Steering Rudder Pin uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address propulsion operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Submarine Steering Rudder Pin?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Submarine Steering Rudder Pin require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. propulsion components receive Heavy-duty passivation 25% HNO3 45min per ASTM B600 for maximum chloride pitting resistance in seawater. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Submarine Steering Rudder Pin shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Rudder pin / Steering pin propulsion components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
